Package org.jlab.coda.emu.support.codaComponent

Enum Class CODAState

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CODAState>
org.jlab.coda.emu.support.codaComponent.CODAState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CODAState>, Constable, CODAStateIF
public enum CODAState extends Enum<CODAState> implements CODAStateIF
This class is an enum which lists all the possible CODA Emu state-machine states. Each of these states has a corresponding set of transitions that are allowed CODATransition. This is the only class that implements the CODAStateIF interface. 

                 *****************
                 * State Machine *
                 *****************
 ____________________________________________________
   INTERMEDIATE  |                 |   INTERMEDIATE
      STATE      |      STATE      |      STATE
 ________________|_________________|_________________

                               (if reset from ERROR or BOOTED)
                  <- BOOTED <-----------------------------,
                 |                                        |
   CONFIGURING   |                                        |
                 |               <------------------------|
                 '-> CONFIGURED ->----------------------->|
                  <-                                      ^
                 |                                        |
   DOWNLOADING   |                                        |
                 |                                        |
                 '-> DOWNLOADED ->----------------------->|
                  <-            <-,<----------,           ^
                 |                ^           ^           |
                 |                |           |           |
   PRESTARTING   |                | ENDING    | ENDING    | reset
                 |                |           |           |
                 '-> PAUSED -----> -----------|---------->|
                  <-                          |           ^
                 |                            |           |
      GOING      |                            |           |
                 |                            |           |
                 '->  ACTIVE  --------------->'---------->'

 __________________________________________________________________

  NOTE: DOWNLOADED can always do a download,
        CONFIGURED can always do a configure, and
        RESET goes from any state to CONFIGURED (to BOOTED if in ERROR or BOOTED state)
